comparison.objective: Hold an object and press a peg, versus tune, lock, and dynamically validate a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual holding and peg pressing share stabilization/force application, but not hex-key seating, collar metering, lock tightening, or iterative response diagnosis.
comparison.success_condition: A successfully pressed peg differs from two safe stops plus setting-retention testing. Record has no specs, insertion depth, or force limits.
comparison.reason: Shared generic bimanual and insertion primitives do not establish overlap; the tested mechanism and outcome differ.
